title: Requirements (_reqs)
description: Desired state documentation. Versioned immutables alongside resources.

sections.name: Purpose
sections.description: _reqs folders define desired state - not necessarily implemented yet. They provide doc points where resources exist and enable validation against spec.

sections.name: Local Rules
sections.description: Reqs live with resources - self-contained, no external dependencies. Each folder owns its reqs. No central registry, no retroactive burden. Resources and their reqs travel together.

commands.description: Lists requirements with name, description, versioned file

sections.name: Versioning
sections.description: Reqs are immutable - new versions create new files
